title: Writing
learning_outcomes: Explain audience and purpose in the context of writing.
Compare and distinguish claims and evidence in the context of writing.
Apply paragraph structure in the context of writing.
Evaluate and justify decisions about revision in the context of writing.

lessons.title: Audience and purpose
lessons.outcome: Explain audience and purpose in the context of writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving audience and purpose; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to edited memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain audience and purpose from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of audience and purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Claims and evidence
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish claims and evidence in the context of writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving claims and evidence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to edited memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain claims and evidence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of claims and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Paragraph structure
lessons.outcome: Apply paragraph structure in the context of writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving paragraph structure; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to edited memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain paragraph structure from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of paragraph structure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Revision
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about revision in the context of writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving revision; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to edited memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain revision from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of audience and purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of claims and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of paragraph structure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
